questions.q: Which clip has the highest temporal variance in the lab, despite having no flicker?
questions.why: Variance counts any change over time. The fade reads 1314.57 and the strobe 25.26.

questions.q: Why does a textured pan score high on the second difference?
options: Edges crossing a pixel make its value zigzag, even with smooth motion
questions.answer: Edges crossing a pixel make its value zigzag, even with smooth motion
questions.why: At 1 pixel a frame it reads 16.898. So a raw score mixes motion with flicker.

questions.q: What happens to the scores after aligning frames?
options: Pans drop to 0, and strobes and boils stay
questions.answer: Pans drop to 0, and strobes and boils stay
questions.why: Undoing a shift removes motion only. The lab prints 0.000 for pans and 19.428 for the strobe.

questions.q: flicker_score returns 0.0 on a 2-frame clip. What does that mean?
options: There was no measurement, since it needs 3 frames
The score failed and should be retried
questions.answer: There was no measurement, since it needs 3 frames
questions.why: The function returns 0.0 for fewer than 3 frames. Treat that as missing.

questions.q: One frame in 32 is 20% too bright. What should you report?
options: The worst moment too, since the mean is 3.2 and the worst is 48.6
questions.answer: The worst moment too, since the mean is 3.2 and the worst is 48.6
questions.why: Averages hide single bad frames, which viewers notice.

questions.q: The H3 dragon clip tops our table. What can you conclude from that alone?
options: Little: fast detail and real flicker both raise this score
questions.answer: Little: fast detail and real flicker both raise this score
questions.why: The clips differ in content and it's one seed. Without alignment the score can't separate the causes.
